description: Which GB300 trays and GPUs exist, where they sit, what they are running and whether they are reporting. Sourced entirely from on-tray node-exporter and dcgm-exporter.

options.content:
Fleet inventory and telemetry coverage for the IREN_MKZ GB300 estate.
Every figure is derived from telemetry the trays push themselves — node-exporter and dcgm-exporter on each DGX GB300 tray. A fully populated rack is 18 trays / 72 GPUs; a fully populated SU is 288 trays / 1,152 GPUs. Each tile is backed by the table beneath it, which prints its own row count (or total) in its footer.
ClusterMinder / CVT: Open worklists · Inventory & coverage · Firmware & config alignment · Cable & Layer-1 vs golden

panels.description: GPUs pushing DCGM telemetry right now. Backed by 'GPUs reporting per tray' below, whose footer total equals this tile.
panels.title: GPUs reporting

panels.description: SUs with at least one reporting tray. Backed row-for-row by 'Coverage by SU — trays and GPUs reporting against a full SU' below: the tile equals that table's row count.

targets.expr: count(count by (su) (up{job=~"node|node-exporter", cluster=~"$cluster", datahall=~"$datahall", su=~"$su", rack=~"$rack", node=~"$node"} == 1))

panels.title: Scalable units reporting

panels.description: Racks with at least one reporting tray. Backed row-for-row by 'Coverage by rack — trays and GPUs reporting against a full rack' below: the tile equals that table's row count.

targets.expr: count(count by (rack) (up{job=~"node|node-exporter", cluster=~"$cluster", datahall=~"$datahall", su=~"$su", rack=~"$rack", node=~"$node"} == 1))

panels.title: Racks reporting

panels.description: Same selector as the 'Scalable units reporting' tile — one row per SU, row count in the footer equals that tile.

defaults.noValue: No tray telemetry in this scope.

targets.expr: count by (su, datahall) (up{job=~"node|node-exporter", cluster=~"$cluster", datahall=~"$datahall", su=~"$su", rack=~"$rack", node=~"$node"} == 1)
count by (su) (DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_TEMP{cluster=~"$cluster", datahall=~"$datahall", su=~"$su", rack=~"$rack", node=~"$node"})

panels.title: Coverage by SU — trays and GPUs reporting against a full SU

panels.description: Same selector as the 'Racks reporting' tile — one row per rack, row count in the footer equals that tile. Short racks sort first.

defaults.noValue: No tray telemetry in this scope.

targets.expr: count by (rack, su) (up{job=~"node|node-exporter", cluster=~"$cluster", datahall=~"$datahall", su=~"$su", rack=~"$rack", node=~"$node"} == 1)
count by (rack) (DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_TEMP{cluster=~"$cluster", datahall=~"$datahall", su=~"$su", rack=~"$rack", node=~"$node"})

panels.title: Coverage by rack — trays and GPUs reporting against a full rack

panels.description: Same selector as the 'GPUs reporting' tile, grouped per tray. The footer sums to the tile. A GB300 tray publishes 4 GPUs — anything less is a telemetry gap.

defaults.noValue: No GPU is publishing DCGM telemetry in this scope.

targets.expr: count by (node, su, rack, datahall) (DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_TEMP{cluster=~"$cluster", datahall=~"$datahall", su=~"$su", rack=~"$rack", node=~"$node"})

panels.title: GPUs reporting per tray — fewest first (footer totals to 'GPUs reporting')

panels.description: Same selector as the 'Trays reporting' tile, joined to SMBIOS and kernel identity. Row count in the footer equals that tile.

defaults.noValue: No tray is reporting in this scope.

targets.expr: (up{job=~"node|node-exporter", cluster=~"$cluster", datahall=~"$datahall", su=~"$su", rack=~"$rack", node=~"$node"} == 1) * on (node) group_left(product_name, product_serial, bios_version, bios_date) node_dmi_info * on (node) group_left(release) node_uname_info

panels.title: Tray roster — the exact trays reporting, with model · serial · BIOS · kernel

panels.description: The longest-running tray — the first row of 'Uptime by tray' beneath.
panels.title: Longest uptime in fleet

panels.description: Trays whose node_boot_time_seconds is less than 24 h old. Backed row-for-row by the table directly beneath it, which uses the identical selector and threshold.

targets.expr: count(time() - node_boot_time_seconds{cluster=~"$cluster", datahall=~"$datahall", su=~"$su", rack=~"$rack", node=~"$node"} < 86400) or vector(0)

panels.title: Trays rebooted in the last 24 h

panels.description: Every reporting tray, longest uptime first — row 1 is the 'Longest uptime in fleet' tile. Amber = up less than 24 h.

defaults.noValue: No tray is reporting a boot time in this scope.

panels.title: Uptime by tray — longest first (row 1 is the tile above)

panels.description: Identical selector and threshold to the tile above; the footer row count equals that tile. Most recently rebooted first.

defaults.noValue: No tray in this scope has rebooted in the last 24 h.

panels.title: Trays rebooted in the last 24 h — the exact trays
